ValidationRule.description: Required for certain values in Reason for Rejection field for PEAK
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(CDE_SOURCE__c, 'PK'), ISBLANK(CDE_REJECT_NOTES__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(CDE_REJECT_APPLN__c, '3'), ISPICKVAL(CDE_REJECT_APPLN__c, '1') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter appropriate notes for rejection.
